steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the RFQ counter-offer option required by the case.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the final event type as RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title using a unique generated title.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Populate the remaining required pricing-sheet values.
Verify the product's automatically populated variant.
Confirm the delivery location was retained.
Add one QA test vendor without inventing a vendor name.

args.goal: open the Schedule Event drawer, set the bidding duration to 15 Mins, set Evaluation time to 30 minutes, save the schedule, and stop on the create screen showing the saved schedule summary

steps.note: Configure and save the separate 30-minute evaluation window, which has no dedicated catalog argument.
Publish the fully configured RFQ event.
Confirm publication reached a real event page.
End the bidding window so the event can transition into its evaluation period.
Return to the events list to inspect the event's resulting status.
Verify the event entered the evaluation state after bidding ended.
